title: Windows export dialog: owned by the app window via the runner, starting in Documents
context: Lab e2e of the PR build showed the Windows export save dialog (file_picker 13.1.0 -> windows_file_picker 2.0.0, shown from a spawned isolate) with no owner: it opened at the screen corner, fell behind the app once the app was clicked while Export stayed busy, and on the first export after a Start-menu launch opened in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Field Notes (the process working folder). The photo picker (image_picker -> file_selector_windows) was correctly owned.
options: lockParentWindow: true only, letting the picker take GetForegroundWindow() at show time
Pass the app window's own HWND from a new runner window-channel method, plus initialDirectory = Documents on Windows
Switch Windows export to file_selector getSaveLocation
Set the process working folder or the shortcut WorkingDir to Documents
outcome: Pass the explicit HWND (runner windowHandle method) with lockParentWindow, and start in Documents on Windows only. GetForegroundWindow can pick another app's window if the user switches away while a large journal zips; file_selector would add a new direct dependency path for one platform; changing the working folder is process-wide. Cost: Windows always opens Documents rather than the last folder used. macOS and Android receive exactly the previous arguments.
